name: Original ceramic field boot
creator: Original Blender-authored asset for Living Superweapon / War World
rights: Original project geometry and material design. No third-party asset licensing obligations.
bankSchema: Flat position/normal/uv/index arrays; Three.js groups and materials arrays; bounds in native boot local space.
texture: None. Ceramic seams, flex ribs, fasteners and sole tread modeled in geometry.
rigContract: Symmetric reusable left/right boot. Replaces geometry/materials on existing native boot driver; no new rig, skeleton, clips, controller or URL load at rig initialization.
limitations: Rigid boot skin; no opening collar, independent toe flex, wear texture or baked AO. Runtime ceramic tint should follow the hero armor.
